intro: Mebok Mizzyrix, an enterprising goblin in Ratchet, believes the cunning of local raptors is stored entirely in their horns. He hires travelers to hunt Sunscale Scytheclaws across the Barrens to collect intact horns for a bizarre commercial venture.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands. And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns! If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks." I could sell them for a fortune!!!
And you can help me. Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws. They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get the horns, friend? Those things are going to make me a fortune!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got them! Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
